Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 0
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscompared particle masses, incorrectly claiming the neutron has the least mass (and giving an erroneous neutron mass ~8.5e-32 kg). In reality, the electron is the least massive; neutrons and protons (and thus the nucleus) are far heavier.
